_README: Single source of truth for what the public build may assert. Each flag maps to a claim ID in brand-reference/CONTENT_FACTS_TO_VERIFY.md. A claim may be set true ONLY after documentary evidence is attached in Claim_Evidence_Tracker.csv and a named corporate reviewer signs off. Templates must never hardcode a claim that has a flag here. As of 2026-11-04 no claim is APPROVED, so every flag ships false.

registeredMark.text: YML is a registered trademark (shows the registered symbol)
registeredMark.evidence: Registry extract: number, mark, owner, classes, jurisdictions

symbolOnGlobalSite.text: The registered symbol may be shown on a globally reachable website

fmcNvocc.evidence: FMC NVOCC list entry, tariff publication, bond

millenniumNetwork.evidence: Membership proof AND written logo permission

associationLogos.evidence: Written permission plus usage rules from each body

houston.role: North America location — Brand Standards forbid the four-country short form until confirmed

photographyLicensed.note: LICENSES_AND_USAGE.md: no approved or licensed photography exists. Each image needs a recorded source, licence type, licence ID and date, and must not imply Yentrans facilities, vessels, staff or shipments.

brandLogoProvisional.note: BRAND_MANIFEST.json sets approved_for_public_website=false and commit_to_public_assets=false for YML_Registered_Logo_PROVISIONAL.png (carries an uncleared registered symbol).

quoteEndpointEnabled.note: No server endpoint provisioned. Quote form falls back to a composed email handoff; it never reports a submission the server did not accept.

applicationEndpointEnabled.note: APPLICATIONS_DISABLED. Needs Cloudflare Pages Functions + Turnstile + R2 + D1 and an approved applicant privacy notice. See DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md.
